subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can say technology words like keyboard, tablet, email and CD player.
I can use verb + noun phrases: carry a bag, call the doctor, study Maths.
I can describe an object for a partner to guess.

tf.why: Yes! You touch the letters on it to write.

tf.s: You use a CD player to send an email.
tf.why: You use a CD player to listen to music.

tf.s: A mobile phone is a small telephone you carry with you.
tf.why: Right! Mobile means you can carry it.

tf.s: You write a letter with a pen and some paper.
tf.why: Yes! An email is on a computer; a letter is on paper.

tf.s: Email and letter are both messages.
tf.why: Great! That's why mouse is the odd one out.

tf.s: A mouse in this lesson is a small animal.
tf.why: Here, a mouse is part of a computer.

tf.s: We say "carry a bag" and "study grammar".
tf.why: Yes! These are verb + noun phrases.

tf.s: A tablet is big and heavy, and you can't touch it.
tf.why: A tablet is small and flat; you touch it to play and read.

tf.s: You can walk around with an old telephone, like a mobile phone.
tf.why: An old telephone stayed in the house; it wasn't mobile.

boxes.q: You touch the letters on it to write. What is it?
boxes.why: A keyboard has letters on it.

boxes.q: You use it to listen to music. What is it?
I ___ my grandma on the phone every Friday.
boxes.why: We call people on the phone.

boxes.q: She ___ her school bag every day.
Which is the odd one out?
boxes.why: Mouse is part of a computer; the others are messages.

boxes.q: A small telephone you carry with you is a ___.
boxes.why: A mobile phone goes everywhere with you.

boxes.q: It's small and flat. You touch it to play games and read.
You send this on a computer.
boxes.why: An email goes from one computer to another.

hunt.q: Flat; you touch it to read

mcq.q: Which list has only technology nouns from the lesson?
Which three verbs are in this lesson?
mcq.why: Carry, call and study are the lesson's verbs.

mcq.q: What do you do with a keyboard?
What is the learning tip in this lesson?
o: Draw a table to remember phrases.
mcq.why: A table helps you remember verb + noun phrases.

mcq.q: Make a table for "play". Which three nouns fit?
o: a bag, a book, a box
mcq.why: We play football, games and the piano.

mcq.q: Write a clue for "tablet". Which is best?
o: It's small and flat. You touch it to play games and read.
You write it with a pen.
You listen to CDs on it.
It is part of a keyboard.

mcq.q: "I've got this thing at home. I do my homework on it. I type on its keyboard." What is it?
mcq.why: A computer has a keyboard for homework.

mcq.q: Why is mouse the odd one out: email, letter, mouse?
o: Mouse is part of a computer; email and letter are messages.
mcq.why: Email and letter are both messages.

mcq.q: Which pair shows then and now?
mcq.why: People wrote letters; now they also send emails.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the verb correctly?
o: I call my bag every day.
I carry the doctor every day.
I study my grandma on the phone.
